notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: combat surf. 20/21 team spawns, AWPs, deagles and grenades placed, three game_player_equip, jails (jail1, jail2, jail_tele) and every other teleport aimed at noob_teleport_1..4 or the ramp top. The black sky is the map's own (skyname sky_schwarz_). chk-maps run 64. Not published.
kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
